description:
Quarterly unemployment rate, number unemployed and labour force for every local council area since late 2010. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: 541 council areas, all states and territories; December quarter 2010 to June quarter 2026. Current to 2026-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/unemployment-lga`.

**Price: 3¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: unemployment_rate, unemployed_persons, labour_force. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_economy_unemployment
title: LGA · Unemployment by council area
